name: Hetzner Storage Box
tagline: High-capacity RAID storage box with WebDAV, SFTP, and automated snapshots.

instructions.navBreadcrumb: Hetzner Robot › Storage Boxes › Manage Credentials
instructions.step1: Open Hetzner Robot and select your Storage Box from the list.
instructions.step2: Enable WebDAV and SSH/SFTP access in your Storage Box settings.
instructions.step3: Enter your username (e.g. u123456), server hostname, and password.

fields.label: Storage Box Username
fields.helper: Your dedicated Storage Box username assigned by Hetzner Robot

fields.label: Server Hostname
